title: Coast Guard medevacs woman from cruise ship near Cape Hinchinbrook, Alaska
description: A Coast Guard Air Station Kodiak, Alaska, MH-60 Jayhawk helicopter crew forward deployed to Cordova, Alaska, medevacs a 76-year-old woman experiencing heart attack symptoms from the cruise ship Star Princess, near Cape Hinchinbrook, Alaska, June 9, 2017. The aircrew hoisted the woman and the cruise ship’s medical specialist and transported them to Cordova where they were transferred to Guardian Flight. Guardian Flight transported the woman and medical specialist to Anchorage for higher care. U.S. Coast Guard video
keywords: Kodiak, hoist, Air Station, MH-60, Jayhawk, Cordova, Forward Operating Location, FOL, medevac, SAR
